notes: Search did not surface a direct seat.com datamanual PDF for the MY12 5-door Ibiza or the Ibiza Maintenance Programme booklet; the MY12 Ibiza SC and MY11 Ibiza ST manuals (same 6J generation) are the closest official documents found, plus the MY14 range manual. Several spammy PDF mirrors (live-work.immigration.govt.nz, clc.fordham.edu, openlearning.sky.it, autoconfig.bps.go.id, sbrc2017.ufpa.br, altnews.in, tinkerine.com, wilson.edu) were excluded as untrustworthy hosts. Haynes 2008-2015 page and Comma Oil CGGB entry are the strongest interval-bearing non-OEM sources. No seat.co.il / Champion Motors service-interval page surfaced; Israeli results were price directories (midrag, d.co.il) and classifieds, excluded. Timing-belt intervals in forums/German pages conflict (60k mi/4y vs 5y/120k km vs 90k km) and must be resolved against official text.
